panel: MiniMax 2.7 + Mimo v2 Pro + DeepSeek v3.2 tiebreaker
known_issues_encountered: First pass: 22/64 rejected at intake due to MiniMax output quirks (evidence_type meta-analysis, short Gaps Identified section, extra Pydantic-incompatible fields). Patched and re-fired.
First pass: 7/64 failed at review stage with provider_error (panel exhausted under burst load). Sequential pacing eliminated this. Final 64/64 are clean panel decisions.
Panel genuinely rejects MiniMax-drafted elite-tier synthesis content at 0% accept rate. This is real, not a concurrency artifact.
interpretation: Panel discriminates correctly: contested evidence flagged 67% of the time (target >= 70%, just below), and elite content is split 35% revise / 65% reject. Zero accepts on 58 elite-tier papers means Researka's current rubric requires higher-quality synthesis than MiniMax produced. Two orthogonal next-step options: (1) LOOSEN the reviewer accept threshold one notch and re-run to see if accept rate climbs to 40-70%. If so, threshold was too strict. If still 0%, the drafter style is the limiting factor. (2) TIGHTEN the drafter's output alignment with what the rubric rewards (shorter, narrower claims, bundle-grounded every sentence) and re-run to measure.
next_validation_step: Loosen accept threshold in reviewer prompt by one calibration notch, re-fire all 64, compare. If accept rate on elite jumps >30%, threshold was the issue. If still <10%, the drafter style is the issue.
